1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju

(Persimpangan Bertingkat Pantai Sentral) 2018.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 13 Disember 2018.

Larangan

2. (1) Pemanduan suatu kenderaan motor dengan kelajuan yang melebihi

had laju yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama di atas jalan yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama dilarang.

(2) Jalan dengan had laju yang dinyatakan di bawah subperenggan (1)

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua.

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

SPEED LIMIT (PANTAI SENTRAL INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(2) of the

Roads Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Speed Limit

(Pantai Sentral Interchange) Order 2018.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 13 December 2018.

Prohibition

2. (1) The driving of a motor vehicle at a speed exceeding the speed limit

specified in column (2) of the First Schedule on the road specified in column (1) of the

First Schedule is prohibited.

(2) The road with speed limit as specified in subparagraph (1) is shown on

the map in the Second Schedule.
